hair.value: dark brown, long, in a queue tied with black ribbon

stature.basis: The queue and black ribbon are attested (Wau-Bun, Mrs. Helm on his scalp, the 15th). Clean-shaven, broad-faced, dark-haired from the captioned engraving (unverified likeness, below). Eye colour, height and build ours. A modern account reads his Miami name as 'carrot', perhaps for red hair; that was not verified in a source read here (lead: P. A. Hutton, Indiana Magazine of History 74, 1978; the site would not open), so the engraving's dark hair is kept and the owner may choose.
